We need to answer based on policy excerpts. The question: "Do I need to fully remove the old two-factor enrolment before adding the new device, or can I just re-scan a new code?" This is about re-enrolling two-factor authentication after losing access. The excerpts say:

- Re-enrolling invalidates the old QR code entirely; only the newly scanned one will generate valid codes afterward. (DOC-012 part 3)
- From Settings → Security → Two-factor authentication, choose “Reset” and re-enrol the same way as a first-time setup — scanning a new QR code and confirming with a fresh six-digit code. A saved recovery code from the original enrolment can also be used to sign in and reset from there if the settings page itself is not reachable without a working code. (DOC-012 part 2)
Thus answer: you don't need to manually remove; resetting will invalidate old and you just scan new. So answer accordingly.
